narrative:
Montgomery County has 364,521 registered voters, with 57.5% unaffiliated or lacking primary history. Republican-leaning voters make up 20.4% of registrants and Democratic-leaning voters account for 22.1%, a narrow Democratic lean of 1.7 percentage points. Millennials are the largest generational cohort at 26.8% of registrants. Registration is trending bluer in younger age cohorts (1990s–2000s births lean +3.5% D−R vs -1.8% for 1950s–60s cohorts).
